svg.title: Compare a saved history checkpoint
svg.desc: The saved checkpoint through event 34 matches a current chain of 35 events. Notes explain file selection, comparison and the limit of local hashes.
svg.text: Does the saved history still match?
A checkpoint records an event count and hash.
Keep a trusted copy outside this database.
Event 34 still matches; the current total is 35.
Later legitimate events do not invalidate it.
Hashes do not encrypt or sign the records.
An administrator can rebuild a local chain.
Read-only comparison. Test checkpoint and fixture history; no operational permissions changed.
